content.content:
/owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
=== OwnerFieldsDto schema ===
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

## Summary

I implemented rejection of owner creation when any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is missing or blank, returning **400** with a JSON body whose top-level `errors` array names each offending field.

There were two validation paths to cover, because the generated `addOwner` interface method carries `@Valid` and the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` has `@NotNull` + `@Size(min=1)`/`@Pattern` constraints:

1. **Missing / malformed fields** (`null` values, non-numeric telephone, etc.) fail Bean Validation *before* the controller runs, throwing `MethodArgumentNotValidException`. In `ExceptionControllerAdvice.handleMethodArgumentNotValidException`, I added an `errors` property to the `ProblemDetail` — the distinct list of field names from the binding result. This is what makes `$.errors` contain `"city"` for the missing-city test.

2. **Present-but-blank fields** — `address`/`city` carry only `@Size(min=1)`, so a whitespace value like `"   "` slips past `@Valid`. To enforce the spec uniformly, I added `validateRequiredOwnerFields(...)` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`, which checks all five fields for null-or-blank and throws a new `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` carrying the field names. A matching `@ExceptionHandler` returns 400 with the same `errors` array shape.

Files changed:
- `rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java` — add `errors` array to validation responses; handle `InvalidOwnerFieldsException`.
- `rest/advice/InvalidOwnerFieldsException.java` — new exception carrying the offending field names.
- `rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java` — blank/missing guard in `addOwner`.

Full suite: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — **BUILD SUCCESS**.
